source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Διονύσιος Επίσκοπος Μιλάνου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's many men of this name is a bishop of Milan; `sisinnius-of-milan`, whom another reader has drafted from saint.gr's 29 Μαΐου, is a different man of the same city. `confessor` is used because the page says he was exiled for his stout stand against the heretics and died in the exile, and does not call his death a martyrdom. The page names a place of exile, Cappadocia, and a see, and no city of birth, so no `locations` object is proposed. No hymn.
